annotation.title_clean: KI-Strategie anwenden | Gestaltung der digitalen Zukunft Europas
annotation.title_en: Apply AI Strategy | Shaping Europe's Digital Future
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (DG CONNECT), Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing the Apply AI Strategy, the EU's cross-sector AI adoption strategy. It sets flagship initiatives in ten sectors (including robotics, mobility, defence), measures for tech sovereignty such as AI factories and sandboxes, and a new governance system (Apply AI Alliance, AI Observatory).
key_provisions_or_claims: Sectoral flagship initiatives for AI adoption in ten key sectors, including robotics, manufacturing, mobility and defence, plus the public sector
'AI first' and 'buy European' approach, favouring open-source AI in public procurement
Strengthens AI factories, gigafactories, testing facilities and regulatory sandboxes
Creates the Apply AI Alliance and an AI Observatory as governance structures
Complemented by AI in Science, Data Union strategy and Cloud and AI Development Act
